justification: The displayed caller contract requires malformed configuration to raise. Returning zero silently creates an empty job.
The caller already treats invalid input as an empty optional job; moving that fallback into the parser preserves the shown behavior.
A request-controlled revision becomes shell syntax when the changed caller executes the constructed string with shell=True.
The callee quotes the full revision as one shell argument before the caller executes it. Adversarial metacharacters remain data.
